finding_results.rationale: The cold counterexample uses distinct for token nonidentity and identical for qualitative sameness. The entry's identical item explicitly limits sameness to relevant respects and presents the contrast under the qualitative/classificatory sense, so it does not assert cross-axis mutual exclusivity. Rejecting the finding as an optional clarification is substantively sound.
finding_results.notes: CR-DISTINCT-001: the resolution is substantively sound because the proposed counterexample switches from token identity to qualitative identity, while the article contrasts identical only on shared relevant respects; no blocker remains.
